THE GAUHATI HIGH COURT
(High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh)
ADVERTISEMENT
HC(K) 131/ DJS/ 2026. Dated Kohima, the 8th October, 2026
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for filling up the following vacant
posts/anticipated vacant posts of Stenographer-Grade-III in the District Courts of Nagaland under
Gauhati High Court, Kohima Bench, Nagaland.

2. Age limits:
Minimum =21 years
Maximum =32 years
Relaxations:
a. Scheduled Tribe (ST): 5 years relaxation (upper age limit of 37 years).
b. Government Employees: Relaxation equal to years of service served subject to a
maximum of 5 years.
The age limit will be determined as on the last date of receipt of application.
3. Eligibility criteria and essential qualification: A candidate, as on the last date of receipt of
online application, must fulfill the following criteria:
i) Graduate in any discipline
ii) 6 (six months Diploma in Computer operation)
iii) 1 year course in shorthand possessing a speed of 80 words per minute
4. Selection Process:
Written examination: 200 marks
1. General English, Precise writing, Essay writing, Drafting translation,
English Grammar -100 marks.
2. General knowledge, Current affairs, Mathematics - 100 marksStage-I
a e
Candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies (1:5) in order of
merit in stage-I will be called for shorthand test of computer
proficiency/typing test.
Stage-II
r I
Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of
merit in the written examination and practical test/speed test will be
called to appear the Interview/Viva voce and verification of documents.
A candidates must secure at least 60% marks in the Interview/Viva
voce i.e. 30 out of 50 marks in order to qualify the Interview/Viva voce.
Stage-III
[4]
N.B Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidates in the
Practical test and the Interview/Viva-Voce subject to having qualified in the respective stages.
Where more than one candidate obtains same grand total marks, the candidate who obtains more
marks in the written examination will get preference. Where the marks obtained by such candidates
in the written examination are also same, then the candidate who is senior in age will get
preference .
5. HOW TO APPLY
Before applying online, candidates must possess a valid e-mail ID and Mobile Number which
are mandatory for registration. E-mail ID should be kept active. Though the system is
designed to send e-mail immediately acknowledging the Registration Code,
sometimes due to network congestion, the e-mail may not be delivered, hence
the candidates are requested to note down the Registration Code.
a. Log on through the websites https://kohimahiqhcourt.gov.in/ and click on 'Online
Application for the posts of Stenographer-Grade-III in District Courts of
Nagaland under Kohima Bench of the Gauhati High Court“.
b. Candidates need to upload scan copies of the following testimonial(s)/certificate (s) at
the time of submission of online application.
i. Documents relating to age proof (admit card/ Birth certificate).
ii. Documents relating to eligibility criteria.
iii. Certificate relating to disability (if any).
c. Application made in any other mode, except as indicated above, shall be summarily
rejected without any communication.

8. Candidate are advised in their own interest to apply online well before the last date and not to

9. TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
/.
//.
Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria will not entitle a candidate to be called for the
Written examination/Practical test/Viva-Voce etc.
Candidates need not submit any testimonials/certificate at the time of submission of
online application. However, candidates have to produce their original testimonials
regarding educational qualifications claim of reservation, date of birth, caste, working
experience (if applicable,) etc. at subsequent stages when asked for.
Number of posts may vary at the time of final selection on either side.///.
[7]
IV. No person, who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a
spouse living or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a
marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to the aforementioned
posts
The admission of candidates at all stages of the selection process shall be purely
provisional and subject to their satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. If, on
verification at any time before or after the selection process, it is found that a
candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility conditions, his/her candidature shall
stand cancelled without any notice. Mere calling of candidate to the Written
examination/ Practical test /Interview etc. or issuance of admits cards/call letter etc.
does not mean acceptance of candidature of any candidate which shall be further
scrutinized at every stage and the High Court reserves the right to reject the
candidature of any candidate at any time.
The provisional list of the candidates, with assigned Roll Nos. will be published in the
High Court websites/District Court websites for the candidates' reference.
No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates for appearing in the Written examination
/Practical test/Interview etc.
For candidate’s reference, answer keys of the question paper for the written
examination will be made available in the Official websites after the examination.
Candidates who are already in the Government Service in State/Central/PSU may
apply after intimating their employers regarding submission of online application
forms for the advertised vacancies. They shall have to produce "No Objection
Certificate" from their present employer at the time of document verification and
"Release Order" at the time of appointment.
The High Court may decide not to issue any admit card/call letter etc. to any
candidate and may decide to call candidates to Written examination/ Practical
test/Viva-Voce etc. by publishing a notification in the official website and notice board
of the High Court/ District Court. Candidates are advised to visit the Official website
(www.qhconline.gov.in and https://kohimahighcourt.gov.in/) of the High
Court/District Court regularly for updates and important information. Unnecessary
correspondence should be avoided.
Application form, which is incomplete in any respect, such as without the photograph
and signature, is liable to be rejected summarily, unless otherwise decided by the
High Court.
The candidates, before applying for the posts, should ensure that they fulfill all the
eligibility conditions. Any information submitted by an applicant in his/her application
will bind the candidate personally. The candidate will be solely responsible for any
mistake made by him/her in the application form and the High Court shall not be
responsible or liable in any way.
The certificate for claim of reservation must be issued by the competent authority.
If any candidate is found canvassing directly or indirectly, his/her
candidature will be rejected.
